title: Corrigir redação com tema gerado e texto dentro do limite
description: Este teste verifica que o visitante consegue gerar um novo tema, escrever uma redação dentro de 50–5000 caracteres e enviar para correção sendo redirecionado para a página de resultados.

steps.description: Navigate to /redacao
Request a new random theme
Fill a valid essay text within the allowed character range into the essay editor
Submit the essay for AI grading
Verify the user is redirected to an essay results page

title: Generate and complete a quiz with results and explanations
description: Verifies that a user can generate a quiz from selected disciplines, answer all questions, submit, and see accuracy results and explanations.

steps.description: Navigate to /questoes
Select one or more disciplines
Generate the quiz
Answer all multiple-choice questions
Submit the answers
Verify the results view shows overall accuracy and per-discipline breakdown
Verify answer explanations are displayed for the questions

title: Log in to reach the account dashboard
description: Ensures a registered user can log in with valid credentials and is redirected to the account dashboard.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Verify the user lands on the account dashboard

title: View account dashboard with profile, stats, achievements, streaks and charts
description: Ensures a logged-in student can access the account dashboard and see profile info, performance stats, achievements/streaks, and progress charts displayed.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill {{LOGIN_USER}} into the email field
Fill {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}} into the password field
Submit the login form
Navigate to /conta
Verify the account dashboard displays the user profile area and performance statistics
Verify achievements or streaks and at least one progress chart are displayed

title: Register a new account and reach the dashboard
description: Ensures a new user can complete registration with valid details and is redirected to the account dashboard.

steps.description: Navigate to /register
Fill in the email field with new.user+{{RANDOM}}@example.com
Fill in the password field with a strong valid password
Fill optional profile fields with valid values
Submit the registration form
Verify the user lands on the account dashboard

title: Protected access redirects unauthenticated user from News Admin
description: Verifies that a visitor who is not logged in cannot access the news admin page and is redirected to login.

steps.description: Navigate to /noticias/admin
Verify the user lands on the login page

Verify the user lands on the essay writing page

title: Redefinir senha com confirmação correta
description: Este teste verifica que o usuário consegue definir uma nova senha com confirmação válida e vê uma confirmação de sucesso com navegação para login.

steps.description: Navigate to /reset-password
Fill a valid new password into the new password field
Fill the same password into the confirmation password field
Submit the password update
Verify a success confirmation is visible and the user is taken to the login page

title: Open an article and see related content

Verify related articles are displayed

title: Read essay grading report and start a new essay
description: Verifies that a user can access an essay results page, view overall and competency scores with feedback and original text, and navigate back to write a new essay.

steps.description: Navigate to /redacao
Generate an essay theme
Fill a valid essay text within the allowed character range into the essay editor
Submit the essay for correction
Wait for the results view to load
Verify the results page displays an overall score and five competency scores with feedback and the original essay text
Click the action to write another essay
Verify the user is back on the essay writing page ready to start a new submission
